title: M-TTS-1: Kokoro-82M integration
description: Implement Kokoro-82M (hexgrad/Kokoro-82M, Apache-2.0) as first real TTS backend. DONE.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: MLX-audio integrated. Kokoro generates real speech on Apple Silicon via mlx-audio. Qwen3-TTS backend also updated to mlx-audio (needs voice cloning for production). All 46 tests pass, make check green, CI green. End-to-end verified: worker generates Kokoro speech, uploads to S3, player plays audio.

right_now_summary: Kokoro-82M now generates and plays real speech on Apple Silicon, with all tests and CI passing.
